intended_use: Regional brain PET research analysis; not clinical decision support

scope.observations: Frame averaged tissue, processed plasma, known input timing and vascular fraction for confirmatory simulation
scope.imaging: Rigid brain PET/MRI; no intraframe or attenuation correction

development.statement: These are regression/development evidence, not untouched external validation

required_gates.title: Automated regression and input contracts
required_gates.criterion: All tests pass, source and installed wheel

required_gates.title: Routine simulation released macro accuracy
required_gates.criterion: At least 80% retained; median absolute macro error <=5%; 95th percentile <=20%

required_gates.title: Large-error risk on routine simulations
required_gates.criterion: One-sided 95% exact binomial upper bound for >50% error among released results <=5%

required_gates.title: Fresh short/noisy/slow-dissociation challenge
required_gates.criterion: No >50% error among released results; at least 10% retained

required_gates.title: Known-transform MRI-derived synthetic PET
required_gates.criterion: Mean landmark error <=2 mm and maximum <=5 mm across fresh poses

required_gates.title: Untouched external kinetic cohort
required_gates.criterion: Independent people and site/tracer with calibrated processed input, prospectively frozen analysis and independent review
required_gates.availability: Not available; prior PBR28/FDG cohorts are exposed

required_gates.title: Independent measured human PET/MRI registration truth
required_gates.criterion: At least 10 measured pairs with independent reference landmarks/transforms; reviewed error tolerance fixed before evaluation
required_gates.availability: RIRE download HTTP 403; no user-supplied images

rules: Freeze protocol before generating new test outcomes
Retain all failures and withheld estimates
Do not change thresholds after viewing holdout results; changes require a new protocol and new holdout
Qualification requires every mandatory gate to pass
Not-run or inaccessible evidence is blocked, never passed
Geometric synthetic truth does not replace measured-human anatomical truth
